frames.note: Windowed 2560x1440, cropped to the client area as engine v2.0.39 captures it (the raw capture was 2562x1472 with the title bar).
Windowed 1600x1200 client area. Taller than 16:9: reads only with games.json scaleMode height; fit places the ROI ~45 px below the badge.
Borderless at 1920x1200 on a 2560x1440 screen: the game upscales x1.2 and pillarboxes itself. OCR reads the comma as a period ('2.000').

2560x1440 at the top of the FOV slider, 116, stored as 83.9863 = 2*atan(tan(58 deg) / (16/9)). The badge sits ~84 px nearer screen centre than the calibrated rect, so the counter reads only once the FOV zoom moves it there. These frames pin the placement, not OCR reliability: at this FOV a single frame reads right about half the time, and these are the ones of six that did. The live plugin holds the value through SignatureConsensus.

Windowed 1920x1440 at the same stored FOV as the 2560x1440 frames: the badge stays on the same row (y~559), so the vertical FOV alone places it whatever the aspect. Covers the height scale mode and the FOV zoom together. 1600x1200 at this FOV is not in this corpus: the digits are ~7 px tall there, too few for OCR on a single frame.
